# Version 4.159.0 (Unreleased)
> **Image comparison and rendering fixes**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.159.0 adds experimental image comparison APIs and fixes rendering and image-decoding behavior. Runtime-effect uniforms start cleared, Windows x64 image error recovery no longer crashes, and Ganesh texture sampling stays inside subset edges. Linux x86 native assets are no longer packaged.

## Breaking Changes

- **Migrate Linux x86 deployments** — Linux x86 native assets are no longer included in NuGet packages. Move 32-bit Linux deployments to a supported architecture, or remain on a release that provides linux-x86 assets. ([#5784](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5784))

## API Surface

- **Experimental image comparison package** — SkiaSharp.Testing compares SKImage, SKBitmap and SKPixmap inputs with channel tolerances, masks, mismatch budgets and error metrics, and creates difference images. The assembly is experimental: opt in to diagnostic SKIA4001 with NoWarn or a pragma. Results retain no native handles; callers own returned difference images. ([#5293](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5293))

## Bug Fixes

- **Runtime-effect uniforms start zeroed** — New SKRuntimeEffectUniforms buffers are cleared instead of exposing uninitialized values. Reset() now zeros the existing buffer in place rather than allocating a replacement, including when reusing mesh uniforms. — ❤️ [@taublast](https://github.com/taublast) ([#5843](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5843))
- **Windows x64 image error recovery no longer crashes** — Fixes a crash in clang-built Windows x64 natives when JPEG or PNG decoding recovers from an error. This also affected PDF output containing lazy non-JPEG images and malformed JPEGs passed to SKCodec.Create. Windows ARM64, x86 and MSVC builds are unchanged. — ❤️ [@SimonCropp](https://github.com/SimonCropp) ([#5827](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5827))
- **Ganesh sampling avoids exterior texels** — Filtered texture-subset sampling clamps slightly inward to avoid reading undefined exterior texels. Ganesh also avoids direct linear copies at affected logical texture edges. Texture-edge pixels may change; CPU and Graphite rendering are unaffected. ([#5679](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5679))
- **Tizen CPU blur selection takes effect** — Tizen now applies its intended CPU blur configuration to Skia, selecting the existing ThreeBoxApprox/Tent paths instead of the shader-based Gaussian candidate. Blur pixels and performance may differ; Tizen rendering and performance were not measured in the source change. ([#5679](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5679))
